content: To begin editing or adding text to this wiki document page, click on the Edit button located above and to the left on this page. Type in the text you wish to add. Once you have completed your edits, click the Save Changes button at the bottom of the page. If you are interested in becoming the Editor-in-Chief for this topic, you may apply. There can be one or more Editors-in-Chief. Additionally, you may apply to serve as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for one of the subtopics listed below. To express your interest in serving as either the Editor-in-Chief for the entire topic or as an Associate Editor-in-Chief for a specific subtopic, please submit your application. Be sure to attach your CV and/or a biographical sketch to your application. The subtopics for this page include the following: Overview Epidemiology and Demographics Risk Factors Screening Pathophysiology and Etiology Molecular Biology Genetics Natural History Diagnosis Differential Diagnosis For information on differentiating galactocele from other causes of breast lumps, click here.
